attempted_claim: Let X1 be CP^2 blown up at one point with its monotone symplectic form. Using an explicit non-triangular almost-toric base diagram with a partial hull (not a triangular Vianna-type diagram), let L0 be the toric monotone fibre and Le a disjoint monotone exotic fibre of Maslov number 2. Is the two-component Lagrangian link L0 union Le jointly Hamiltonian non-displaceable as a link, with pearl-complex Floer homology HF^*(L0, rho0) and HF^*(Le, rhoe) both nonvanishing for explicit rank-one local systems rho0, rhoe and with nonvanishing mixed link Floer data obstructing a Hamiltonian that displaces the pair simultaneously, even though each component may be individually displaced from a fixed third fibre? A complete answer proves or disproves this by exhibiting the non-triangular diagram and both disjoint fibres, enumerating Maslov-2 disks and writing both disk potentials, computing both pearl differentials with rho0 and rhoe, computing the mixed strip complex between L0 and Le, and either producing the joint displacement obstruction or an explicit Hamiltonian displacing the link.
claim_type: joint link non-displaceability with mixed Floer entanglement
decisive_failure: value: Even taking correctness and novelty as given, the headline is not independently worth retrieving later under the shared STANDARD. It is the one-line monomial observation that X+Y+XY+1/(XY) equals X+1/(XY)+Y+XY after y=1/(XY), i.e. a mere parameter substitution / torus reparametrization, with Groebner and numerical tables as pure certification. Certification alone does not create value per STANDARD. It rules out only one arbitrarily chosen single-slide ansatz (w=(0,1), f=1+x) with no proved exhaustive scan of single-slide possibilities, does not resolve any part of the admitted link non-displaceability question, produces no exotic fibre, no pearl/mixed differential, and no new classification boundary; the asserted lesson that genuine exoticity needs iterated/triangular mutations restates Vianna without proof. This is exactly the STANDARD's reject class: correct and new yet a textbook-level substitution / unexplained single-case computation with no demonstrated downstream need. The defect is intrinsic low value and arbitrary scope, not a missing citation fix.
